title: QC gate test broken pattern
subtitle: Deliberately broken fixture for the completeness gate test.
excerpt: A throwaway fixture used to prove the completeness publish gate blocks a skeleton. It carries the qc-fix scaffold placeholder, a leaked NaN and undefined, and no row instructions.

crochet.gaugeText: 16 dc x 20 rows = 10 x 10 cm in DK with a 4 mm hook.

content.text: This is a throwaway test fixture created to validate the content-completeness publish gate. The intro is deliberately long enough to clear the hundred-character minimum so the structural and placeholder checks are what fire, rather than the short-body rule.
Step-by-step instructions for QC gate test broken pattern go here.
Foundation: chain NaN. The final stitch count came out undefined.
